ShortDescription.Value: Random street and district names at the click of a dice button, from vanilla, curated or your own name lists.

Publish.LongDescription:
Tired of naming every street and district yourself? **Roll a Name** adds a dice button next to the name in a street's or district's info panel. Click it to roll a new random name, and keep rolling until you find one you like.
## Features - **Dice button**: roll a random name for any street or district from its info panel. - **Automatic naming** (optional, off by default): newly built streets and newly drawn districts get a random name right away. - **Choose your name sources**, separately for streets and districts. Tick any combination and each name is picked from one of them: - **Vanilla names**: the game's own street and district names, in the language you play in. - **Curated names**: names built from hand-picked prefixes, names and suffixes, like "Oakbrook Avenue", "Harrington Lane", "Old Ashford" or "Maple Heights". Think of it as an expansion pack for the vanilla names. - **Your own names**: add one name per line to StreetNames.txt or DistrictNames.txt. The settings have a button that opens the folder. - Translated into all 12 game languages.
## Safe to remove Names are saved as normal custom names, so they stay in your save even if you remove the mod. Automatic naming only applies to new streets and districts: editing a road or district keeps its current name.
## Coming next Streets and districts are just the start. Future updates will add random names for: - **Buildings**: homes, companies, city services, parks and landmarks - **Citizens** - **Vehicles** - **Animals**: pets and wildlife - **Transit lines**
## Feedback Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/Diogo8500/CS2Mod-RandomNamesGenerator
